## Data Source & Licensing (if proposing a new DEM or overlay)
GridForge only integrates **openly licensed, key-free** geospatial datasets (Public Domain, ODbL, CC BY 3.0/4.0, Copernicus DEM — never CC BY-NC or proprietary tiles).
